blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY, Philippines — The number of recorded HIV cases in this city has reached 812, with local health authorities intensifying efforts to identify an estimated 500 people who may be living with the virus but have yet to be diagnosed. Dr. Virgilio Clement Bilalat, Medical Officer IV of the City Health Services Office (CHSO), said Baguio had recorded 800 HIV cases as of December 2025, with 12 additional cases documented from January to March. All 12 newly recorded cases were male, most of them identified as men who have sex with men (MSM), while most were between 15 and 34 […]...
